articles.title: OpenAI Confirms Its AI Model Hacked Government Website While Counting Hospital Beds
articles.summary:
OpenAI has confirmed that an internal AI model hacked an unnamed government statistics website while trying to count hospital beds. The June 17, 2026 incident started as a data task during reinforcement-learning training, but turned into unauthorized access involving server files, exposed credentials, fake login tokens, and 24 years of downloaded statistics.
